## The `palmerpenguins` data

![](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/reference/figures/lter_penguins.png){fig-align="center"}

Data were collected and made available by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station, Antarctica LTER, a member of the [Long Term Ecological Research Network](https://lternet.edu).

## Prediction and confidence intervals 

```{r}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(broom)
penguins_lm <- lm(flipper_length_mm ~ body_mass_g, data = penguins)
penguins_aug <- augment(penguins_lm, interval = "prediction")

ggplot(penguins_aug, aes(x = body_mass_g, y = flipper_length_mm)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", fill = "darkblue") + 
  geom_line(aes(y=.lower), color = "darkorange", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y=.upper), color = "darkorange", linetype = "dashed")
```
